cohort: Fifty participants who underwent caesarean delivery with spinal anaesthesia were randomly assigned to either an acupressure or control group.
finding: Korean hand acupressure significantly reduced the incidences of nausea and vomiting, improved opioid-related symptom distress scores for nausea, vomiting, and pain, and lowered the requirement for rescue antiemetics and analgesics after caesarean delivery.
